主要内容: The Walt Disney Company entered into a new $1.5 billion 364-Day Credit Agreement on March 15, 2013. The new facility will expire on March 14, 2014, and includes an option for the Registrant to extend the maturity date of all or a portion of advances outstanding at the time of maturity for one year. The new facility allows the Registrant to borrow at LIBOR-based rates plus a spread, subject to a cap and a floor that vary with the Registrant’s debt rating. The remaining provisions of the new facility, including representations, warranties, covenants, and events of default, are substantially similar to the provisions of the existing five-year facility. The new facility contains only one financial covenant, relating to interest coverage, and specifically excludes certain entities, including Euro Disney, Hong Kong Disneyland, and Shanghai Disney Resort, from any representations, covenants, or events of default. A copy of the new 364-Day Credit Agreement is filed herewith as Exhibit 10.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.
